### Ask Questions 🤔 

Can't find what you are looking for in the documentation, then raise a question or just jump in there and hang out while helping others.

- ❓ &nbsp;[StackOverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/c/ecosystem/questions/tagged/enterprise-gateway) - Ask and answer questions with tag "<STACKOVERFLOW_TAG>" to get help from the community or check out [frequent questions](https://stackoverflow.com/c/ecosystem/questions/tagged/<STACKOVERFLOW_TAG>?sort=frequent&pageSize=15).

> &nbsp;
> ##### Asking quality questions
> 
> Spending time framing a question and adding support links or resources makes it much easier to offer help. It’s easy to
> fall into the trap of asking something too specific when you’re close to a problem. Then, those trying to help you out
> have to spend a lot of time asking additional questions to understand what you are hoping to achieve.
> 
> Spending the extra time up front can help save everyone time in the long run.
> * Try to define what you need help with:
>    * Is there something in particular you want to do?
>    * What problem are you encountering and what steps have you taken to try and fix it?
>    * Is there a concept you’re not understanding?
> * Search to see if a similar question has been asked.
> * If possible, provide sample code.
> &nbsp;

### Report Bugs / Request Enhancements
GitHub is our office, it's the place where our development team does its work. We use the issue list to keep track of bugs, enhancements and tech-debt that we are working on. We do this openly for transparency. Please do a search the open issues in GitHub to see if a similar bug, tech-debt or enhancement request has already been filed.

If you find your issue already exists, make relevant comments and add your [reaction](https://github.com/blog/2119-add-reactions-to-pull-requests-issues-and-comments). Use a reaction in place of a "+1" comment.
- 👍 &nbsp;- upvote
- 👎 &nbsp;- downvote

If you cannot find an existing issue that describes your bug or enhancement, submit a new issue.

-->

> &nbsp;
> #### Writing good issues
>File a single issue per problem or enhancement request.
> - Do not enumerate multiple bugs or enhancement requests in the same issue.
> - Do not add your issue as a comment to an existing issue unless it's for the identical input. Many issues look similar, but have different causes.
>
> The more information you can provide, the more likely someone will be successful reproducing the issue and finding a fix.
> &nbsp;

#### Issue Closure policy
* Issues that don't have the information requested above or in the issue templates (when applicable) will be closed immediately and the poster directed to the support guidelines.
* Issues that go a week without a response from original poster are subject to closure at maintainer's discretion.
